account_key.description: Path to the Let's Encrypt account private key file.

csr.description: Path to the certificate signing request (CSR) file.

acme_dir.description: Path to the ACME challenge directory (must be served at /.well-known/acme-challenge/).

disable_check.description: Disable the challenge file accessibility check before submitting to the CA.

output_file.description: Path to write the resulting signed certificate chain.

log_file.description: Path to the log file for stderr output (append mode).
